prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting low back pain and stiffness. Diagnosis was lumbar strain. Over the course of care, the patient completed 25 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for a strain of this type, and progress was gradual with fluctuating symptoms. Examination findings included paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion, which are consistent with the reported injury. Other testing, including neurological screening and straight leg raise, was within normal limits. No prior injury involving the same region of the back is known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. At this time, it is not yet clear to what extent the presenting back complaints are attributable to this collision, and further records would be needed to make that determination. Patient was discharged from active care with a home exercise program and advised to follow up as needed.
